question: Which finished electronics campaign had our worst ROI, and what was it?
gold_sql: SELECT c.name, c.start_date, c.end_date, p.total_profit / NULLIF(c.actual_operating_cost, 0) AS roi FROM campaigns c JOIN departments d ON d.department_id = c.department_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT SUM(cp.profit) AS total_profit FROM campaign_products cp WHERE cp.campaign_id = c.campaign_id) p ON TRUE WHERE d.name = 'Consumer Electronics' AND c.status = 'finished' AND c.end_date < DATE '2026-10-15' AND c.actual_operating_cost IS NOT NULL AND c.actual_operating_cost <> 0 AND p.total_profit IS NOT NULL ORDER BY roi ASC, c.start_date DESC, c.campaign_id DESC LIMIT 1

WITH campaign_roi AS (
  SELECT
    c.campaign_id,
    c.name,
    c.actual_operating_cost,
    COALESCE(SUM(m.gmv), 0) AS total_gmv,
    (COALESCE(SUM(m.gmv), 0) - c.actual_operating_cost) / NULLIF(c.actual_operating_cost, 0) AS roi
  FROM campaigns c
  JOIN departments d ON d.department_id = c.department_id
  LEFT JOIN campaign_metrics m ON m.campaign_id = c.campaign_id
  WHERE d.name = 'Consumer Electronics'
    AND LOWER(c.status) IN ('completed', 'finished')
    AND c.end_date < DATE '2026-10-15'
  GROUP BY c.campaign_id, c.name, c.actual_operating_cost
)

ORDER BY roi ASC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1;
